notes: The manual text only says the PIR's three pins connect to the Raspberry Pi and gives no pin assignments or circuit image. I assumed the standard wiring: VCC to 5V, OUT to GPIO4, GND to GND.
The catalogue lists the rpi-4b with a single GPIO_HEADER port. I used individual header pin names (5V, GPIO4, GND) as the task instructions say, so these ports are not in the catalogue entry.
No breadboard is used. Each of the three male-to-female jumper wires connects one PIR pin directly to a Pi header pin.
Which end of each wire is male and which is female isn't specified. I assumed end 'a' goes to the PIR pin and end 'b' goes to the Pi header.
The manual is marked DRAFT and is incomplete.
